bias.en: Uptrend pausing · back at the $525 resistance
bias.zh: 上升趋势暂停 · 回到 $525 阻力

read.en: Microsoft rose 0.7% on Oct 23 to $524.51, trading between $515.70 and $525.77 on light volume (0.64 times average). It is below the falling 5-day ($528.8) and rising 10-day ($533.1) averages, and above the rising 30-day ($517.8), 100-day ($459.9) and 200-day ($436.5). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 19 but is above zero, histogram widening; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 16 ($547.92), and RSI is 53.
read.zh: 微软 10月23日上涨 0.7%，收于 $524.51，盘中区间 $515.70–525.77，成交清淡（为平均水平的 0.64 倍）。股价位于下行的 5 日（$528.8）和上行的 10 日均线（$533.1）下方，高于上行的 30 日（$517.8）、100 日（$459.9）和 200 日均线（$436.5）。MACD 自 10月19日起位于信号线下方，但仍在零轴上方，柱状图扩大；抛物线 SAR 自 10月16日起看空（$547.92），RSI 为 53。

read.en: The $515.7 low dipped under the 30-day average, but the close recovered to the $524.4–525 resistance. Resistance is $524.4–525.8, then $528.8–533.1 (5 and 10-day) and $544 (Oct 16 high). Support is $515.7–517.8 (Oct 23 low, 30-day), then $497–502 (Sep 25–29 lows) and $486 (Sep 10 low). A close above $525.8 would target $533; a close below $515.7 would open $497–502.

r.en: Oct 16 low $524.4; Oct 21 low $525.0; Oct 23 high $525.8
